output.reason: The linked PR [ev-be7b495ffc4a] says what changed: Karpenter now writes a taint that has no value into Bottlerocket settings with a leading colon before the effect. Without that colon, the Bottlerocket instance could not register with the cluster. The changed files [ev-586dee25060d][ev-6e8791f4bfdf] show the change is in the Bottlerocket bootstrap userdata code (pkg/providers/amifamily/bootstrap/bottlerocket.go), and the release note is [ev-5506a0d4614a].
